findings.evidence: Spec requirement 'The Claude writer credential is scoped to the writer process' ends with 'The token file location SHALL be read-denied inside the sandbox.' In template/scripts/sandboxed_writer.py, build_profile takes no token-file argument, and deny_read is only DENY_READ_HOME + protected + platform. launch_sandboxed_writer never passes the token path. The token_file can be any path, such as /tmp/x or ~/secrets/tok. It is covered only if it happens to sit under ~/.config/dev-platform, ~/.claude or ~/Library/Application Support. The tests do not assert it either.
findings.summary: The spec requires the token file location to be read-denied inside the sandbox. The generated profile never adds the configured token_file path to denyRead.

findings.evidence: proposal.md: 'denyWrite the integration checkout, its shared gitdir and every registered worktree, the push remote path when local, ...'. launch_sandboxed_writer calls build_profile(checkout, home, tmp, protected=protected_paths(integration_root), platform_root) with no extra_deny_write. protected_paths does not inspect remotes. A local bare push remote therefore stays writable only if it lies outside allowWrite, and nothing denies it explicitly.
findings.summary: The proposal says the push remote path is write-denied when it is local. The launch primitive never computes or passes it, so extra_deny_write is always empty.
